messages:
maria: Drafted an SI onboarding + certification roadmap in the drive. Need quick feedback before we send to the SI leads.
lee: Looks good overall. Please add a clear table of marketplace dependencies and any metadata we will require for certified SIs.
jamal: SE ask: we need a pre-provisioned dev tenant, a sample webhook->Redwood integration repo, and an automated smoke test for reliable demos.
sophia: Proposal: three cert tiers (Integrator, Advanced Integrator, Partner Engineer). Each requires labs + a reference deployment review. Co-brand badge and marketplace visibility.
anita: DevEx will build 3 short LMS labs (quickstart, embeddings, ops). Prefer self-serve plus a proctored capstone for higher tiers. Example smoke test: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"ping"}'` expect non-empty output.
lee: For hardware partners (NVIDIA/Lambda/CoreWeave) add a validation checklist (driver/CUDA versions, nv_peer_mem, NIC MTU) and a bootable lab image. Request partner lab credits for workshops.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: staging supports custom metadata fields. See https://docs.redwood.com/partner/marketplace-staging.
maria: Access ops question: who owns dev tenant provisioning and service account playbook? We need a short KMS/HSM sign-off path for private deployments.
jamal: Ops should own provisioning. I'll draft templates for service accounts, scopes, and KMS steps and share for security review.
sophia: Rubric suggestion: 50% labs, 30% deployment review (72h staging run), 20% exam (30m scenario). Add a verify_cert URL in marketplace listing.
anita: Request minimal model pack (configs + quant profiles) and two deterministic prompt templates so labs are repeatable. I can hook up badge issuance via API.
lee: Also define an internal escalation path for hardware blockers: single-threaded contact jamal -> infra-support -> partner-eng.
maria: Timeline: share draft with SI leads in 4 days, kickoff workshop in 3 weeks, pilot cohort starts week 6. I'll consolidate feedback and post updated playbook by EOD Friday. React :thumbsup: if you agree or call out blockers.
